evals.name: Database Platform Selection
evals.prompt: We're currently running PostgreSQL on-prem with manual DBA processes. The team wants to move to a managed database service. Use the decision-engine skill to create an ADR that evaluates RDS vs. Cloud SQL vs. staying on-prem, following my personal decision-making patterns. Include selection criteria, hybrid adoption considerations, and explicit rejection rationale.
evals.expected_output: Complete ADR following the template structure: Context with pressure point and primary drivers, Decision section with 2-3 destinations and selection criteria, Considered Alternatives with pros/cons, What We're NOT Doing section, Consequences, and TODOs

evals.name: AI Agent Architecture Decision
evals.prompt: We're building an AI agent platform and need to decide between: (1) Building on AWS Bedrock with their managed tools, (2) Using LangChain/LangGraph with self-hosted deployment, (3) Adopting a vendor platform like Agent Core or Agent Garden. Apply my decision-making framework - specifically looking for hybrid adoption patterns and component-level evaluation rather than platform-level decisions.
evals.expected_output: ADR showing hybrid adoption pattern - evaluating components separately (memory, tools, deployment, protocol), explicit selection criteria for when to use each option, and clear documentation of what components to adopt vs. build vs. reject

evals.name: Migration Strategy Formulation
evals.prompt: We need to migrate 50 legacy services from on-prem VMs to Kubernetes. Create an ADR for the migration strategy using my decision patterns. Should we do big-bang, incremental by service, or strangler fig pattern? Evaluate the tradeoff dimensions I typically use.
evals.expected_output: ADR with Context showing current operational burden, Decision choosing incremental approach with explicit rejection of big-bang, selection criteria for migration sequencing, and deprioritization rationale

evals.name: Build vs Buy Evaluation
evals.prompt: We need a feature flag system. The team is debating building one vs. buying LaunchDarkly vs. using Flagsmith open source. Walk through my decision framework including the 6 primary drivers, status quo as alternative, and explicit 'What We're NOT Doing' documentation.
evals.expected_output: ADR evaluating all 3 options with structured pros/cons, selection criteria, rejection rationale for each option not chosen, and TODOs for implementation details
